description: Check whether still images of a project show the SAME character as its character sheet — before paid clips are made from them. Each image is compared against the sheet's detail and fullbody views. It judges identity (species, build, colouring, head shape, large markings), NOT style, light, pose, place or props — and deliberately NOT micro details like an ear notch or the number of fingers, which no image model holds reliably. Free. Runs in the BACKGROUND: returns a `job_id` with HTTP 202 — poll it with lab_get_job until status is done|failed; the result lists per image passt, sicherheit, abweichungen, begruendung (or error). Up to 16 images per call, all completed images of this project. The sheet needs a reference image (lab_generate_character_reference).

character_id.description: Character sheet id the images should show — positive integer as string

image_ids.description: Completed image ids of this project (from lab_generate/lab_auto_storyboard) — positive integer strings, no duplicates

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

name: lab_identitaet_pruefen
title: Identity Check
